name: LowWhalesong.wav
description: My voice, three "moans" slowed down/pitch changed with reverb added to sound like a humpback whale. Might need to use noise reduction for the popping/clicking when you use it. I made this because Icouldn't find a good clear whale song.

name: Underwater recording of Humpback whales and their calves
description: Underwater recording of Humpback whales migrating north up the eastern coast of Queensland, Australia. Recorded with an Aquarian Audio H2a hydrophone at 3m depth on August 15th, 2017. There was a fair amount of crackle in this recording, apparently from sand and stones washing over the coral below so I've applied a small amount of noise reduction to remove this.

name: MBARI_MARS_2017_1107h22_HumpbackWhaleSongSession.wav
description:
Are you a fan of humpback whale (Megaptera novaeangliae) song? If so, then the MBARI_MARS long playing (LP) series of humpback whale song recordings is for you. This recording is the first in the series.

Each of these recordings contains hours of continuous song captured with a quiet ocean background in deep water off Santa Cruz, California. These recordings are from an oceanic soundscape project. More information is available about this research and education project as well as the occurrence of humpback whale song off central California.

The recording was made on 7 November 2017 and is available for your creative endeavors under the Creative Commons license. Please acknowledge Monterey Bay Aquarium Research Institute as the source of the recording.

name: coast_guard_zodiac_14may2007_05.mp3
description: A genuine AGUASONIC® recording of the sound of outboard motors (underwater) as a Coast Guard Zodiac went by at full throttle on their way to meeting the wayward Humpback whales lost in the Sacramento River. Recorded on the 14th of May, 2007, about three miles east of Rio Vista, California.
